definitions.explanation: A period of strong economic growth and activity.

examples.japanese: {景気|けいき}は{好況|こうきょう}だ。
{好況|こうきょう}が{続|つづ}いている。

notes:
{好況|こうきょう} refers to economic prosperity or a boom period—when business is thriving.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {好況|こうきょう}に{沸|わ}く: to be in the midst of a boom
- {空前|くうぜん}の{好況|こうきょう}: unprecedented prosperity
- {好況|こうきょう}が{続|つづ}く: prosperity continues
- {好況|こうきょう}{時|じ}: during good economic times

CONTRAST:
- {好況|こうきょう}: prosperity, boom
- {不況|ふきょう}: recession, depression
- {景気|けいき}: economic conditions (general term)

KANJI:
{好|こう} (good) + {況|きょう} (condition) = good economic condition.
